The '''Ashas Ree system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] found in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The system of Ashas Ree was first mentioned in the [[1996]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', written by [[George R. Strayton]] and published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
